text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping in the shopping 
district... I spotted two familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san! Thank you for guiding me to 
the greengrocer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm just glad I could help. Let's 
do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sandwiches are surprisingly deep. Even the 
way you slice vegetables can change the 
taste.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! I do not entirely understand, but 
I have just obtained some incredible 
knowledge!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san! What else?! What other secrets 
do you possess?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, there are a few other things, but... 
Still, the most important thing of all is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... B-But rather than a tip, this is 
just my personal belief. It might not be 
very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! Pray, explain! As the diligent Class 
President...! I must know by any means 
necessary!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
By any means... A-All right! Though it 
really is just like a little good luck 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Pouring your heart into making it." 
That's my personal rule.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo! Ohohooooo! Pouring one's heart into 
making it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Wondering, "Will they like this?" and 
hoping bright smiles will blossom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I pick ingredients and cook like 
that... I feel like it turns out even 
tastier. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Ooooohhhh~! I see, I see, I understand 
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heart is also crucial in cooking... In 
other words! I want to energize everyone! 
I want them to bakushin! I must infuse it 
with that spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And thus! I must choose ingredients and 
cook to make that happen...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That's wonderful! Then let's start by 
choosing ingredients that give lots of 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let us head immediately to the 
Japanese sweets shop!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! Aren't we making sandwiches??

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to ingredients that give 
bakushin energy, it has to be sakura 
mochi!! That is common sense in my 
household!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come, this way! I have a Japanese sweets 
shop I frequent!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wahwahwah!! U-Um, wait! Why don't we go 
back and ask everyone first...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The foods that give people energy might be 
different for each person...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on time and circumstances, there 
are things more important than speed.
